name: Bridge Yoga Centre
reason: Too thin and out of date: a small family-run Iyengar studio near Killaloe, Co. Clare (teacher Kathy Anning) whose site offers only weekly studio, live-online and children's classes with no prices, workshops, trainings or retreats; the class page still carries COVID-era booking rules, and the 'why do yoga' page frames much of the work around named conditions (back problems, blood pressure, mental health). Fewer than about 3 usable items. robots.txt absent (404); email contact@bridgeyogacentre.com is published.
